description: Diagnose information lost by a mathematical representation and refine it to support intended observations and operations. Use when equal summaries hide different outcomes, a proposed composition law fails, or a calculus needs additional dependence, sign, transition, or remainder data. Distinguish lost information from a false target, a false law, an object-class failure, and a missing estimate; use finite partition refinement when explicit finite models fit.
